hero.description: Aerial view of a small section of the Houston Ship Channel on Buffalo Bayou, which leads upstream directly into the city of Houston, Texas, USA. The downtown section of Houston can be seen at upper right. The city of Galena Park, Texas is at center right in this photograph. The U.S. Army Corps of Engineers dredges and maintains the channel for deepwater shipping. View is to the west.
